title: Factor a chain map with K-flat source through a K-flat target
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site small relative to the module universe [def-weil-size-convention] and $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings. Use sheaves of $R$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules], K-flat complexes [def-pc-kflat-complex], and quasi-isomorphisms [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules]. For every chain map $t:D^\bullet\to I^\bullet$ with $D^\bullet$ K-flat, there are a K-flat complex $N^\bullet$ and chain maps $u:D^\bullet\to N^\bullet$ and $c:N^\bullet\to I^\bullet$ such that $c$ is a quasi-isomorphism and $t$ is chain homotopic to $c\circ u$. Chain homotopic means that there are maps $h^i:D^i\to I^{i-1}$ with $t^i-(c\circ u)^i=d_I^{i-1}h^i+h^{i+1}d_D^i$ for every $i$. If every term of $D^\bullet$ is flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], then $N^\bullet$ can also be chosen with flat terms.
